description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePictureController class, which handles the retrieval and serving of employee picture files in the OrangeHRM application. It interacts with the EmployeePictureService to get employee photos based on employee number, manages HTTP response headers, and serves default images when necessary.

classes.name: EmployeePictureController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee picture file requests, retrieving employee images, and serving them with appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeePictureService.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to retrieve and serve the employee's picture, or a default image if not found, with appropriate caching headers.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers related to caching and content type on the response object.
